notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Altar Golem.
Altar Golem has a power of at least five.
Altar Golem does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Altar Golem by tapping it, creating at least five 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Altar Golem by tapping five Elemental tokens, untapping Altar Golem.
Repeat.
